6064629376919798254.description: Damp with the memory of misted groves, these bracers guide the hand in silence. Every motion feels half-remembered, like a story passed from leaf to leaf.

6064629449229074443.title: Ceremonial Dagger
6064629449229074443.description: The dagger is crafted of a black metal. It has the title "Goblin Slayer" on one side of the blade and "Koburn" on the opposite.

6064629576834285590.description: A vial of herb essence, distilled as cleanly as possible

6064629642265296920.description: This is a coarse belt made from strands of cyclops hair. It has a waning arcane resonance.

6064629653236482054.description: A curious looking tome made with a leathery hide and adorned with odd gems.

6064629959857733717.title: The Seal of Torment
6064629959857733717.description: This enchanted gem bears a magical rune and gives one a sense of dread when held tightly..

6064629998234370055.title: Caravan
6064629998234370055.description: Use: Deploy your caravan within range of the caravansary. After 2 minutes, your caravan will be summoned.
more: A useful piece of technology, used to magically summon a caravan from a distance.

6064630010921746434.title: Phoenix Gryphon
6064630010921746434.description:
Flying Mount
Level 25

165% Ground Speed
215% Flying Speed
500% Maximum Health
more: Wreathed in embers and crowned with flame-kissed plumage, the Phoenix Gryphon blazes across the skies above Sunhaven like a living omen of rebirth and wrath. Its leonine frame radiates heat with every bound, while its wings unfurl in a brilliant flare of copper and gold, trailing sparks that never fall. Forged in volcanic storms and tempered by centuries of wildfire, it carries with it the legacy of survival through ruin and triumph through trial. A creature of myth made manifest, the Phoenix Gryphon symbolizes more than strength and leadership; it is the embodiment of relentless resurgence. Only the Mayor of Sunhaven may claim its loyalty, for only one who has endured fire without being consumed may ride such a mount.

6064630101690089631.title: Horse Beast Of Burden
6064630101690089631.description: A fine beast trained to pull caravans.

6064630140366225518.title: Novice Fishing Satchel
more: A great start to your fishing journey.

6064630140443820149.title: Journeyman Lumberjack's Tool Belt
6064630140443820149.description: Crafted from storm-cured hide and fitted with brass buckles, this belt was crafted to hold the weight of steel and ritual.

6064630140761145468.title: Journeyman Weaponsmith's Tool Belt
6064630140761145468.description: Faint script burnt into the leather of this heat-scored, metal-scented belt reads, "Iron shapes the hand." The wearer won't see this message until their hands have earned the privilege.

6064630140765864062.title: Apprentice Weaponsmith's Skivvies
6064630140765864062.description: These flame-resistant, soot-tinged foundational leggings, generally worn beneath leather and iron, aren't undergarments--they're a weaponsmith's first layer of discipline.

6064630140830548112.title: Apprentice Carpenter's Skivvies
6064630140830548112.description: Knee-worn and grain-flecked, these pants flex with every measured stroke. Pockets sag slightly with sawdust and skill.

6064630141128802449.title: Journeyman Jeweler's Tool Belt
6064630141128802449.description: Each felt-lined pouch dampens the vibrations of even the finest precision tools. Modeled after a belt designed by a deaf jeweler who taught his students to find a gem's fault line by touch alone.

6064630141160652960.title: Apprentice Metalworker's Skivvies
6064630141160652960.description: Woven from soot-darkened cotton and lined with ember-resistant wool, these undergarments have survived more blisters than their wearers. They never burn--just wilt slowly, like pride under pressure.

6064630141163405474.title: Journeyman Metalworker's Tool Belt
6064630141163405474.description: Tooled from boiled oxhide, this belt holds hammer, chisel, punch, and pride in careful alignment. It doesn't sag under weight--it reminds you how to carry it.

6064630141187719342.title: Novice Lumber Miller's Shirt
6064630141187719342.description: Serviceable, but not particularly flattering; though neither is the mill. It might not protect your pride--but it'll protect your hide.

6064630197031403593.title: The Bull Roarer
6064630197031403593.description: A grand battle axe that once belonged to the minotaur hero, Vultauro the Bull. It roars with magic when swung.

sources.name: Take the Oubliette to the Cryptmonger.

6064630417662607519.title: Wolf Beast Of Burden

6064630417664180477.description: Carved with curling sigils drawn from river eddies, this band was once worn by a boundary-walker who vanished upstream. Its touch calls to hidden paths and carries the pulse of waters that forget no name.

6064630657027997945.title: Ashen Haunt's Bracers
6064630657027997945.description: These bracers speak of battles unfinished; to victories that will never be won.

6064630657027997966.title: Ashen Haunt's Belt
6064630657027997966.description: Don this belt, and you may hear the distant cry of a lost army, marching ever onward.

6064630673006002188.title: Ashen Essence
6064630673006002188.description: A bit of crystalized essence left from the corpse of an Ashen Haunt. Used for crafting of weapons and armor.

6064631007296487450.title: Map of the Sacrifice Rune
6064631007296487450.description: This is a hastily sketched map of the location of a goblin rune stone. This Rune of Sacrifice is found in the ruins of Korra'Loch.

sources.name: Having encountered similar glyphs, you notice that this a goblin rune. It depicts goblins spilling the blood of many aelans. The blood forms a river running to a volcano. This is a goblin Sacrafice Rune!

6064631081012101155.title: TO: The Eye of the Needle
6064631081012101155.description: This is large package of artisan resources. It bears the mark of the Greyshore Transporters.

sources.name: Splendid! I thought you might be agreeable. The only stipulation is the courtesy of utmost discretion. It's a matter political uncertainty, and surely a sign of troubling times ahead.
This is a large pile of cargo bags that were enroute to various artisan workshops outside of  Aela. Someone needs to deliver them.

6064631081019899941.title: TO: Candor's Kettle
6064631081019899941.description: This is large package of artisan resources. It bears the mark of the Greyshore Transporters.

6064631113761947656.title: Rusty Greataxe
6064631113761947656.description: A rugged, dependable tool turned weapon, carried by those who've stopped asking questions and started clearing their own path. It's not a hero's blade--it's a survivor's rejoinder.

6064631121005117457.title: Wyrmling
6064631121005117457.description:
Flying Mount
Level 25

165% Ground Speed
215% Flying Speed
500% Maximum Health
more: Clad in bronze scales that shimmer like sunlit armor, the Wyrmling is the ember-born offspring of a militant legacy. Though small in stature, it carries the spirit of an ancient fire, coiled tight within a frame still learning its place in the skies. Its breath is smoke and promise, its eyes twin coals that burn with challenge and curiosity. Tempered by flame and ferocity, it yields to no hand that has not earned its trust through trial. Once bound, however, its loyalty is fierce and unshakable, a bond forged not by dominance, but by mutual will. The Mayor of Halcyon holds that bond, rising into the storm-laced heavens astride a creature that may yet grow into legend.

6064631154540085248.title: Forsaken Blades Dirk
6064631154540085248.description: Deadly, pragmatic weapons issued to scouts, sentries, and silent killers stationed along the ramparts of the Citadel of the Steel Bloom. Built for intimidation and range, it is a tool of suppression and shadow--not honor.

6064631188653211689.title: TO: Briarmoor Estates
6064631188653211689.description: Property of the Greyshore Transport Company, Riverlands Post. Deliver to: The Briarmoor Estate. Deposit on Freight Deliveries.

6064631188676411438.title: TO: Bearskin Boone
6064631188676411438.description: Property of the Greyshore Transport Company, Riverlands Post. Deliver to: Bearskin Boone's Trading Post.

6064631193964249268.title: Bough Warden's Recurve
6064631193964249268.description: Bough Wardens were said to mark their kills by planting seeds at the site of each fall. This bow remembers them all--and grows stronger for it.

6064631199655133212.title: The Stonemother's Ring
6064631199655133212.description: A dwarvish band forged for their matriarchal leader, said to allow her to sculpt the world as she sees fit.

6064631200513851504.title: Recipe: Terrorgore Hide Leggings
6064631200513851504.description: Apprentice Armorsmithing recipe for creating Terrorgore Hide Leggings.

6064631211409015605.title: Talon's Wrack
6064631211409015605.description: A wicked, named blade of cruel precision and jagged intent. This isn't just a dirk--it's an open wound that chooses where to go next.

6064631211744493595.title: Grizzler's Hide
more: This hide is covered in matted, oily tangles of bear fur. Its heavy stink of old musk and dried blood is nearly choking.

6064631228619948114.title: Recipe: Grizzler Hide Sleeves
6064631228619948114.description: Journeyman Leatherworking recipe for Grizzler Hide Sleeves.

6064631233880850480.title: Codified Index
6064631233880850480.description: A dense, disciplined tome of structured spellcraft, etched in sacred numerals and ruled lines. It does not simply suggest spells--it imposes order upon them.

6064631234104197187.title: Whispered Thoughts
6064631234104197187.description: The perimeter of these hoops is carved to resemble the spines of tiny books. Fine script engraved on the inside bears the initials ERQ.

6064631234242609259.title: Boots of the Tardy
6064631234242609259.description: The soles never scuff, never rush--yet somehow arrive just in time.

6064631234397798748.title: Steward's Breeches
6064631234397798748.description: Though the gardens are lost, the gardner's walk remains--measured, meditative, lost in unseen bloom.

6064631234479391224.title: Silkwind Leggings
6064631234479391224.description: Threaded with spell-stitched grace, the silk seems to draw from the breeze itself, quickening the wearer's pace with each gust.

6064631234583003828.title: Carrig's Cufflinks
6064631234583003828.description:
Drop: Financier Carrig 
Ingredient In: Tailoring
more: Carrig the scholar's bronze cloth laced cufflinks.

6064631234584642237.title: Sweeper's Leather Scraps
6064631234584642237.description:
Drop: Eternal Sweeper 
Ingredient In: Leatherworking
more: Ripped dirty leather scraps from a zombie.

6064631250910904351.title: Recipe: Boots of the Tardy
6064631250910904351.description: Journeyman Leatherworking recipe for Boots of the Tardy.

6064631284556235382.title: The Eye of Seafury
6064631284556235382.description: An antique spyglass of nautical design. It is engraved with the name, "Captain Seafury."

sources.name: "there in the middle, a firefly tree."

6064631363406004295.title: Briarmoor Taxes
6064631363406004295.description: A strongbox that contains many coins. It bears the symbol of the Kaelar and the name 'Briarmoor."

sources.name: A strongbox of utilitarian design. The crest of the Kaelar Empire is burned into the lid. "Property of the Kaelar Empire Tax Commissioner."

6064631363889528909.title: The Bellsong Code
6064631363889528909.description: An ancient tome filled with complex diagrams and codes. A stamp on the inside reads, 'Property of the Carphin Chronological Society.'

sources.name: The Bellsong Code is a collection of Olek Bellsong's most complex formulas and theoretical probabilities. Only the greatest comprehension can make sense of the vast amount of knowledge held within the pages of this grimoire. The original text was lost. A copy of the grimoire can be produced by this unit.

6064631504639492099.title: Poorly Written Note
6064631504639492099.description: Next caravan strike is tonight. Meet at the Trinnin River bridge close to Gemspring. Burn this after reading!

6064631629194264583.title: Stone of Tura'Madu
6064631629194264583.description: This smooth stone has a crest of Tura'Madu on it. Within the crest you can barely make out the eroding name, 'Djrak.'

sources.name: [The rocks in this area are similar to those of the Grave Marker, they have been scattered.]

6064631680504692774.title: Tattered Note
6064631680504692774.description: Although tattered, the note appears to be recently written.

sources.name: This appears to be a small supply stash. Most of the resources are used. There is nothing of use.
["Stay put here. The supplies will last till we can get you. You've made the right choice. No turning back now. Welcome to the Highwaymen."]

6064631709522722816.title: Novice Minor Gold Reduction Enchanting Scroll

6064632451610443786.title: Songs of the Sands
6064632451610443786.description: The Song of the Sands is a popular book of old Vaelune traditionals, this version is an older translation - but most of the stories are still familiar.

sources.name: A parcel of lost luggage, most likely dropped by newcomers to Verra on their way to a nearby settlement. This is the sort of thing you were supposed to bring to a representative of the Striders Vigilant.

6064632507063861281.title: Court of Cloaks Key
6064632507063861281.description: This key feels very cold. It almost gives you frostbite. It is made of a mysterious enchanted etheral metal. It will vanish into nothing within a matter of seconds.

sources.name: Aye! The Plunder awaits. The list is on the barrel there and the chest awaits its gifts, as do the Court of Cloaks. [He hands you a key.]

6064632700272186216.description: An ancient horn, once Wiyakoni's, earned through years of wisdom and service. Cracked with age, it symbolizes his vision, guiding the Ashen Flame toward peace, unity, and a future of harmony and trade.

6064632734612652327.description: Bound in layered segments to turn the edge of blade or branch, the seams stitched close to keep out the dust of the high passes.

6064633073090036630.title: Guild War Defectors Declaration Scroll - Miraleth
6064633073090036630.description:
DISABLED WHILE INVESTIGATING ISSUES
A Guild Master may consume this scroll to declare war on another Guild.

Defector and Rebel camps will be unconvered. Destroy the Defectors and protect the Rebels to gain victory points.

The first guild to reach 500 victory points win.

6064633073111794588.description:

6064633237818834944.title: Eagle Gryphon
6064633237818834944.description:
Flying Mount
Level 25

165% Ground Speed
215% Flying Speed
500% Maximum Health

For PTR use only.

6064633267269533697.title: Befallen Anvil
6064633267269533697.description: The accursed anvil of Braithreach is forged of an otherwordly marbled-looking steel. It is more than twice the size of a common anvil, but is pitted and roughly formed except for the mirror-bright work surface. It eternally glows a dull orange, shifting in hue like a banked coal.

6064633271860133894.title: Voided Siege Declaration Banner - Korrin
6064633271860133894.description: Voided siege declaration due to price issues.

6064633272383635459.title: Sunfire Stonebound Twin Daggers
6064633272383635459.description: The weight sits a touch deeper in the hand, with a quarry cool shine along the flats.

6064633272384290820.title: Glorybound Stonebind Twin Daggers
6064633272384290820.description: A pale glint gathers at the edge, a winter calm that never quite leaves the metal.

6064633272384815109.title: Forsaken Hexblades
6064633272384815109.description: Finn, in a blur of steel, slit throats in the culvert's shadows. Raze, his twin, held her daggers differently. Each cut, a twist of the blade, pulled essence into a focused point. The air crackled with power. Guards didn't just fall; they erupted in flame, froze mid-step, or simply blinked out of existence.

6064633288742731781.title: Om'Lokk Chalk
6064633288742731781.description:
Drop: Lokk the Ragebringer 
Ingredient In: Armorsmithing
more: "Om'Lokk Chalk" is a whitish calcite rock most commonly used by the Om'Lokk tribe of Desert Giant. It has a smooth texture, easily leaving transient marks on stone and wood. The Om'Lokk use it to designate trails and sacred sites, and sometimes wear it as a decorative gemstone.

6064633289002844174.title: Peculiar Pearl
more: A misshapen pearl, with surfaces that swirl and dip like miniature dunes. Patches of light and dark play across its surface, shifting with the angle of view.

6064633289003302931.title: Bit of Flint
6064633289003302931.description:
Drop: Professor Gurax 
Ingredient In: Arcane Engineering
more: A squared-off bit of stone, worn where it has been repeatedly stricken with a steel to drive a spark.

6064633289012019225.title: Bubblebauble
6064633289012019225.description:
Drop: Malrhos Dar'kuu Gravekeeper 
Ingredient In: Leatherworking
more: An uncommon blue-green crystal formed under intense pressure deep in the sea. These gems shimmer with an ethereal glow that recalls light filtering through the waves. They are often found woven into the clothing and jewelry of Sea Giants, to whom they hold some unknown arcane significance.

6064633289012543518.title: Elemental Heart of Flame
more: Olek Bellsong working steadfast in his tower, hammered the unruly elemental core, splitting it in two! This half, a heart of furious embers, crackles with intense crimson flame.

6064633289542336553.title: Mouth of Oblivion
6064633289542336553.description: A plate of glossy obsidian scattered with grains of glittering golden sand that mirror the firmament. If this is held in an ungloved hand, the bearer's mind fills with a chorus of unending cries.

6064633289607020544.title: Iguana
6064633289607020544.description:
Gather: Turquoise Sea, Jundark 
Ingredient In: Animal Husbandry

6064633289733505344.title: Flamedancer
6064633289733505344.description: Professor Gurax was the supreme warden of the lighthouses of Bellsong. Initially opposed to the summoning of fire elementals, he relented after seeing its efficiency.

6064633289833972168.title: Codex of Seafire
6064633289833972168.description: Murgul was both a proud Dunir and an inquisitive mage. He was known as the father of the Flamecasting, a naval tactic that employed mages to lob fire attacks upon distant pirate ships.

6064633289859858921.title: Shatterfist
6064633289859858921.description: The arcane warhammer that shook the life out of the giant king, Kohuk. Engineered by the legendary giantslayer, Khemlut.

sources.name: A Magical Bag Of Mixed Goodies

Ingredient In: Lumber Milling, Arcane Engineering, Carpentry

6064633338868334779.description: A customized wheel for your caravan.

6064633338876854460.title: Date Palm Caravan Wheels
6064633338876854460.description: A customized wheel for your caravan.

6064633372784787458.title: Basic Cargo Hold
more: (Certain Ship Stats are currently Work In Progress, may not function as intended.)

6064633408195985410.title: Novice Glintic Residuum - Weapon
6064633408195985410.description: A spectral wisp of magic's purest form, bound to no master, resides within these fragments of unusually volatile Glint.

6064633419063623682.title: Joshua Tree Rooting Ball
6064633419063623682.description: This self-fertilizing root ball that will grow a Joshua Tree when planted in a freehold.

6064633419686412299.title: Journeyman Tempering Kit - Armor
6064633419686412299.description:
A small, sturdy wooden box, polished to a soft sheen. Inside, nestled in compartments lined with dark velvet, are collected the required elements of magical enchantment. The lid is adorned with a small emblem, signifying the type of gear the kit is designed to enhance.
This kit can only be used on equipment of equal or lesser grade than itself; attempts to temper higher-tier gear are magically inhibited and cannot even be initiated.

6064633430592849048.title: Oily Scale
6064633430592849048.description:
Drop: Ironhide Basilisk 
Ingredient In: Arcane Engineering
more: A palm-sized scute, with an iridescent pattern that reflects light in an oily sheen. Rare, but valuable in crafting protective raiment, these scales serve as formidable armor, providing both flexibility and formidable defense.

6064633430593373337.title: Wiry Sinew
6064633430593373337.description:
Drop: Zagrazoo the Eyeless 
Ingredient In: Tailoring
more: Surprisingly lightweight, yet exceptionally tough and flexible, basilisk sinew is superlative material for stitching strong plates into lamellar. Naturally resistant to tearing and abrasion, this sinew is ideal for crafting strong and supple items like ropes or armor.

6064633430595142812.title: Kreeok Broadfeather
6064633430595142812.description:
Drop: Talon-Master Folkan 
Ingredient In: Leatherworking
more: Large, durable feathers with bands of vibrant color, provide excellent camouflage in Verra's jungles. Jundark Hunters typically use these to cover their hoods, breaking up their profile, and demonstrating a unique cultural flair.

6064633430596387998.title: Kreedown
6064633430596387998.description:
Drop: Bind-Master Hakoa 
Ingredient In: Leatherworking
more: Impossibly soft, and naturally waterproof. Jundark hunters commonly employ Kreedown wherever padding is necessary, from the knuckles of their gauntlets to the pillows in their bedrolls.

6064633430605235373.title: Binding Nail
6064633430605235373.description:
Drop: Sir Jenry The Strong 
Ingredient In: Weaponsmithing
more: A single, ancient nail of blackened bronze, etched with nigh invisible glyphs of mountains and lightning. It appears mundane at first glance, yet grows steadily warmer if held tightly. The head is square and slightly irregular - hand-forged, not machine-made - and the point is still wickedly sharp.

6064633447764721680.title: Warden Shillelagh
6064633447764721680.description: Crafted by a forgotten druidic order, the Shillelegh would be handed down to guardians of the crystal codex. Rich in the arcane essence of a corrupted heartwood, a branch such as this becomes a magical force of survival.

6064633447852146946.title: Iron Wing Guantlets
6064633447852146946.description: The broken wings of Kreeok warriors will always be mended as long as the hands of the Bind Master are present on the battlefield. Through gauntlets dipped in the Pools of Stench, his mending powers give new life to injured warriors.

6064633452958842882.title: Starfish
6064633452958842882.description:
Gather: Turquoise Sea 
Ingredient In: Cooking

6064633527215915466.description: Cut for a wide range of movement, they keep the stride smooth whether weaving through market streets or climbing the forge stairs.

6064633537443594241.title: Surplus Equipment Token
6064633537443594241.description: The Kaelar Empire authorizes disseminating surplus arms and armor to adventurers that prove their worth. Can be exchanged with Surplus Equipment Vendor at any settlement greater than level 1.

6064633730640052317.title: Journal Page
6064633730640052317.description: A torn, hastily scrawled journal page. From the few legible lines, it appears to have been ripped from a settler's journal.

6064633776249241710.title: Crown of Whispered Wisdom
6064633776249241710.description: One might recognize the style of the Toren decoration, but what makes this crown unique is the voidsteel--a twisted, foreign metal unknown to any forge of this world.

6064633776299901043.title: Altar of Rebirth
6064633776299901043.description: The fractured stone slab of an altar of transformation, used to break and reshape flesh and bone to fit the tortured designs of a cruel mind.

6064633855265275908.title: Eddledom
6064633855265275908.description:
Gather: Anvils 
Ingredient In: Lumber Milling

6064633860906680330.title: Thornway Accord Vestment
6064633860906680330.description: Those who wore it swore no oaths aloud, but the glade still remembers.

6064633860908187677.title: Tithebrook Treads
6064633860908187677.description: Carries a steady rhythm when walking alone, as if accounting for something just behind.

6064633860910743615.title: Scorchwander Backplate
6064633860910743615.description: Formed in the lee of sun-shattered cliffs, this backplate bears the faint ripple of heat long since fled. Travelers claim it dampens the sting of midday glare and carries the hush of shifting sands.

6064633860910743620.title: Scorchwander  Pauldrons
6064633860910743620.description: Shaped to deflect both heat and harm, these pauldrons are traced with faint ridges that catch the breeze. They carry the silence of distant watchmen who once stood alone at the edge of the storm.

6064633860916248731.title: Brinetread Boots
6064633860916248731.description: Step steady on slick boards and wave-washed rock, the soles gripping as surely as barnacle to hull.

6064633860916248733.title: Brinetread Bracers
6064633860916248733.description: Guard the forearms without binding them, shaped to deflect a strike while keeping the hands free for quick work.

6064633860917887157.title: Ferncloak Jerkin
6064633860917887157.description: Balanced between flexibility and defense, its panels sit light enough for long patrols yet strong enough to hold in the press of a fight.

6064633860917887160.title: Ferncloak Bracers
6064633860917887160.description: Wrap the forearms in a guard shaped to glance aside a blow without slowing the hand's next move.

6064633860917887162.title: Ferncloak Gloves
6064633860917887162.description: Hold with the certainty of roots in rich soil, steady whether drawing a blade or pushing aside a branch.

6064633860918411460.title: Slagwalker Belt
6064633860918411460.description: A wide cinch band with layered straps, its clasp carved in the likeness of a molten stream spilling into its channel.

6064633860918739142.title: Wavebound Cape
6064633860918739142.description: A flowing mantle that takes the wind with it, rippling like deep water under the sun, its edges whispering in the sea's own voice.

6064633860919066831.title: Dunecoil Cape
6064633860919066831.description: Wraps in layered folds that turn with the body like sand curling along the crest of a dune, its edges trailing the heat-shimmer of the open desert.

6064633860919525593.title: Gloomraider Jerkin
6064633860919525593.description: Built to guard the body without slowing it, its layered panels flex as easily in a charge as in the silent wait before it begins.

6064633860920312040.title: Wildmarch Belt
6064633860920312040.description: A plain but well-worn clasp secures it, the leather supple from years of pulling tight before the march begins again.

6064633860920901875.title: Tidepiercer Cape
6064633860920901875.description: A streaming mantle that moves like the tide, its edge darkened where spray and brine have worked their patient will.

6064633860920901880.title: Tidepiercer Pauldrons
6064633860920901880.description: Curved high to deflect spray and strike, their lines echo the coiling arc of deep-sea current.

6064633860920901882.title: Tidepiercer Belt
6064633860920901882.description: A flat-banded cinch with a clasp in the shape of a leaping fish, worn smooth by the turn of years at sea.

6064633860921229570.title: Scorchmantle Gauntlets
6064633860921229570.description: Fitted to lock at the wrist with a precise clasp, ready to grasp rope, reign, or blade in the bright glare of noon.

6064633860921229572.title: Scorchmantle Helm
6064633860921229572.description: A visor-shaded dome that narrows the light to a usable sliver, its shape breaking the endless reflection of the dunes.

6064633860921491717.title: Duskhunter Cape
6064633860921491717.description: Falls in muted folds the color of shadowed leaves, its edges breaking the wearer's shape as they move through the half-light beneath the canopy.

6064633860921491722.title: Duskhunter Shoulders
6064633860921491722.description: Set low and angled, deflecting a strike and sliding past branches so the path remains unbroken.

6064633860947050784.title: Deepward Bastion Backplate
6064633860947050784.description: This shielded spine of the forgehalls was shaped to bear the crush of falling stone and the press of unspoken burden. Its weight recalls the silence of tunnels too deep for echoes.

6064633860947050790.title: Deepward Bastion Greaves
6064633860947050790.description: Cut for slow, steady advance through rubble and heat, these greaves were not built for speed. They were built to outlast fear.

6064633860948820283.title: Verdant Yoke Cloak
6064633860948820283.description: A mantle woven from root-thread and briar cord, said to tighten when lies are near. The weight across the shoulders whispers of old pacts still honored in the deep woods.

6064633860948820288.title: Verdant Yoke Helm
6064633860948820288.description: Shaped like a split seed pod, this helm hums faintly in rain. Its eye slits bloom with clarity beneath shaded canopy.

6064633860949147976.title: Crownbreaker Gauntlets
6064633860949147976.description: The fingers are jointed like the roots of dead trees, once dipped in the blood-warm silt of a drowned king's hold. They grip with the certainty of those who fought not to rule, but to remember.

6064633860971823460.title: Sunwrought Helm
6064633860971823460.description: Forged with the bearing of forgotten sovereigns, this helm reflects no heat and casts no shadow, as if the sun itself once paused to regard the one who wore it.

6064633860983685544.title: Brineplate Cuirass
6064633860983685544.description: Encases its wearer in the unyielding calm of the abyss, each plate a guardian of the heart against the chaos of battle, steeped in the silence that has swallowed fleets whole.

6064633860983947698.title: Sunbastion Boots
6064633860983947698.description: Step evenly over dune and stone, their weight balanced to keep the stride steady even where the ground shifts without warning.

6064633860983947702.title: Sunbastion Greaves
6064633860983947702.description: Carry the legs forward with the same confidence as a desert caravan on a well-worn route, untroubled by the rise and fall of the sand.

6064633860984275388.title: Graveplate Bracers
6064633860984275388.description: Grip the forearms with the same surety as the vines that wind around forgotten stones, lending unshakable control to every movement.

6064633860985061826.title: Ironwake Cape
6064633860985061826.description: Flows behind like the banner of a fortress at dawn, its length stirring with the steady rhythm of the steps that carry it forward.

6064633860985717196.title: Coralhold Cuirass
6064633860985717196.description: Carries the shape of the ocean's bastions, enclosing the heart in the still power that lies within the coral groves where predators fear to linger.

6064633860986044889.title: Scaldplate Helm
6064633860986044889.description: Shades the eyes against the blinding glare, turning the gaze into a narrow, unflinching line toward the next objective.

6064633860987224556.title: Stoneglen Greaves
6064633860987224556.description: Carry the legs with the balance of one crossing both open pasture and the narrow steps of watchtowers.

6064633860987486706.title: Anvilguard Bracers
6064633860987486706.description: Bands of unwavering defense, they steady the arms for strikes measured as carefully as a master mason's cut.

6064633860987945471.title: Reefguard Pauldrons
6064633860987945471.description: Rise from the shoulders as the reef rises from the depths, breaking the force of what comes against it.

6064633860988666374.title: Sandbastion Helm
6064633860988666374.description: Shades the gaze from the punishing glare, the eyes beneath unblinking in the face of windblown grit or the glint of a drawn blade.

6064633860989321740.title: Tombplate Boots
6064633860989321740.description: Their tread is measured and deliberate, gripping damp earth and moss-slick stone with the surety of one who knows what waits in the dark.

6064633860997710356.title: Emberwake Trousers
6064633860997710356.description: They whisper in step only when silence is absolute.

6064633860998300192.title: Thistlemaw Vestment
6064633860998300192.description: Said to bloom briefly under moonlight, then fade by morning without ever opening.

6064633860998562346.title: Runebreath Treads
6064633860998562346.description: At every third step, the air stills. Not from sound, but from something waiting.

6064633861005247061.title: Shell of the Sanctifier Belt
6064633861005247061.description: Worn at the threshold between will and motion, this band bears the sigils of forgotten paths walked beneath desert stars, each loop a tether to vows once spoken in sand and silence.

6064633861005247063.title: Shell of the Sanctifier Boots
6064633861005247063.description: Shaped for long crossings beneath breathless suns, these boots remember each sacred step pressed into shifting sands. Their soles carry the hush of temple floors and the echoes of prayers too faint to rise.

6064633861010162335.title: Seafoam Boots
6064633861010162335.description: Tread surely on wet planks and slick stone, their step as confident in the shallows as on dry land.

6064633861010162337.title: Seafoam Gloves
6064633861010162337.description: Hold firm in spray and salt air, the grip steady whether hauling a line or drawing steel.

6064633861010752172.title: Shadeweft Hood
6064633861010752172.description: Falls low over the face, breaking the line of the head and folding it into the surrounding dark.

6064633861012521674.title: Mistglean Waist
6064633861012521674.description: Knots securely at the hip, its tails moving with the same easy sway as kelp stirred by a gentle tide.

6064633861012521676.title: Mistglean Feet
6064633861012521676.description: Step sure on slick deck planks and tide-wet stone, their tread gripping where the water runs thin.

6064633861013832423.title: Brightgrove Boots
6064633861013832423.description: Step with the balance of one who knows the paths beneath the canopy, gripping root and stone alike without breaking stride.

6064633861014029036.title: Ashveil Leggings
6064633861014029036.description: Move with the body through crouch, climb, or sprint, their cut favoring agility in tight ground or shifting slopes.

6064633861014291196.title: Seawisp Cape
6064633861014291196.description: Trails in delicate folds like mist over moonlit water, its edges lifting with each step as though caught in an unseen tide.

6064633861234177383.title: Runic Sigil
6064633861234177383.description: A round, flat sigil carved from dusky red stone. On one side, an inscription of a rune is engraved onto the surface.

6064633867116413099.title: Stormcurrent Great Grimoire

6064633867120214193.title: Runeweld Dagger
6064633867120214193.description: The blade bears faint markings that no tool can scrape away, even worn near to nothing. It rests oddly in the hand, as if guided by intention more than grip.

6064633867124211901.title: Shadowfang Twin Daggers
6064633867124211901.description: The edge drinks light until it is little more than a shadow in the hand.

6064633867181883616.title: Ironhearth Longbow
6064633867181883616.description: Stiff and exacting, the Ironhearth Longbow requires strength and stillness in equal measure. When drawn, it creaks like settling stone and holds steady even in strong wind.

6064633867186733295.title: Shadowfang Longbow
6064633867186733295.description: The curve swallows light, leaving only a dim edge at the string.

6064633867187519729.title: Wavecutter Longbow
6064633867187519729.description: Sleek and deliberate, shaped for swiftness through air like a blade in water.

6064633867188699382.title: Glassveil Longbow
6064633867188699382.description: Its pale surface catches light in shifting veils, like desert glass under noon sun.

6064633867203051784.title: Pyrebrand Mace
6064633867203051784.description: The metal holds a subdued ember tone, reminiscent of banked coals before dawn.

6064633867231887694.title: Mirageborn Rapier
6064633867231887694.description: Contours waver like wind drawn dune lines, then return to a true, unwavering thrust.

6064633867232280911.title: Nightreaver Rapier
6064633867232280911.description: Matte dark finish swallows the room, leaving the blade's intent more than its shape.

6064633867236475224.title: Mistwood Scepter
6064633867236475224.description: Wound in moss and soft to the grasp, the Mistwood Scepter drips slowly when drawn from its wrappings. It leaves no mark where it touches, yet nearby leaves quiver when it stirs.

6064633867243553131.title: Deepweld Scepter
6064633867243553131.description: Dense core and hammered plates, the grip warm as stone that remembers the hearth.

6064633867249844604.title: Seabright Shield
6064633867249844604.description: Salt bright sheen and spray cut channels guide water away, light skimming its curve like a gull.

6064633867251220866.title: Nightreaver Shield
6064633867251220866.description: Matte surface drinks the lantern glow, leaving only a broad, silent outline beneath the canopy.

6064633867251614083.title: Deepweld Shield
6064633867251614083.description: Plates sit close as quarried stone, the face burnished to a calm forge sheen that steadies the stance.

6064633867258495385.title: Mirageborn Shortbow
6064633867258495385.description: Contours waver in heat shimmer, then align as the breath evens.

6064633867259150747.title: Deepweld Shortbow
6064633867259150747.description: Stout tips and a tempered arc keep the quiet assurance of stone warmed by the hearth.

6064633867268522416.title: Ashbrand Spear
6064633867268522416.description: Balanced with grim intent, its haft bears the memory of fallen holds and the silence that followed.

6064633867270750645.title: Pyrebrand Spear
6064633867270750645.description: Its head is dark with the memory of old flames quenched in the Anvils' rain.

6064633867276845511.title: Sandcarved Sword
6064633867276845511.description: Etched by wind and ruin, this blade carries the whisper of shifting dunes and buried secrets.

6064633867279073744.title: Sunscorch Sword
6064633867279073744.description: Its surface holds the glare of a sun at zenith, harsh enough to blind the unwary. The grip is warm, as though it remembers the forge's final breath.

6064633867296440839.title: Stormcurrent Wand
6064633867296440839.description: Its surface gleams as though damp with unseen rain. A faint scent of the sea drifts from it.

6064633895622737938.title: Mount Cosmetic: Tidebreaker
6064633895622737938.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Rising from the deep with a hull-thick hide and eyes like churning whirlpools, the Tidebreaker is a mount shaped by storm and surf. Its steps shake the shallows and send foam crashing skyward. Few steeds are as dependable when the path turns to sea.

6064633895686897709.title: Cosmetic: Adolescent Faybeast
6064633895686897709.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of specific pets when you equip it.

6064633895693975604.title: Mount Cosmetic: Cinderhorn Steer
6064633895693975604.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: A living ember carved in the shape of a beast, the Cinderhorn Steer is a favorite among Verra?s traveling troupes. With molten veins and a fiery glare, it storms onto the stage to thunderous applause, its presence marking the height of every explosive performance. The Merrymaker Troupe, known for their pyrotechnic pageantry, spares no effort in capturing and training these blazing creatures, whose dramatic entrances light the night and ignite the crowd.

6064633895700332597.title: Cosmetic: Servant of the Soil
6064633895700332597.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of specific mounts when you equip it.

6064633895710949437.title: Cosmetic: Truffle Trotter
6064633895710949437.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of specific mounts when you equip it.

6064633895716454467.title: Cosmetic: Talltuft Calf
6064633895716454467.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of specific mounts when you equip it.

6064633895723401286.title: Mount Cosmetic: Timeless Terrapin
6064633895723401286.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Ancient and immense, the Timeless Terrapin lumbers across the land as though time itself moves around it. Covered in moss and stone, it is said to carry echoes of lost ages upon its broad shell. As a mount, it offers patience, stability, and a quiet strength unmatched by swifter beasts.

6064633895763050584.title: Cosmetic: Hefty Capling
6064633895763050584.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of specific mounts when you equip it.

6064633895763312729.title: Mount Cosmetic: Dredgehorn
6064633895763312729.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Lumbering and lumpy, the Dredgehorn is an amphibious brute that trades elegance for raw utility. Its primary weapon is a lightning-fast tongue that can yank prey from a distance, though when provoked, it charges headlong with a horn strong enough to shatter bone. Tamed through sheer patience and copious amounts of marsh grubs, the Dredgehorn serves as a functional, if stomach-turning mount for riders with strong legs and stronger stomachs. Few creatures can match its power in wetlands or boggy terrain, where its bulk and spring-loaded stride offer surprising mobility.

6064633895769931867.title: Mount Cosmetic: Maelstrom's Crown
6064633895769931867.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your aquatic mount.
more: Cloaked in roiling mist and streaked with veins of crackling light, Maelstrom?s Crown is a mount born of the storm. Each step hums with pent-up energy, and its mane dances like lightning caught mid-strike. Riders speak of hearing distant thunder even when the skies are clear, and the air around it always feels just a touch heavier. To ride one is to court chaos, but also command it.

6064633895792935016.title: Cosmetic: Starkin
6064633895792935016.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of specific mounts when you equip it.

6064633895797588075.title: Mount Cosmetic: Fateborn Nightwing
6064633895797588075.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Vast of wing and veiled in silence, the Fateborn Nightwing drifts through the skies like a shadow of forgotten prophecy. Once trusted by the Py?rai to guide their flights across the wild expanse, these flying beasts are revered not for their power, but for their presence. Their wings stir the air with barely a sound, carrying rider and memory alike across great distances. More than a mount, the Nightwing is a companion born of old magic and quiet reverence, forever bound to those who ride with purpose.

6064633895797915757.title: Mount Cosmetic: Boulderstone Bulldog
6064633895797915757.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Thick of frame and thicker of will, the Boulderstone Bulldog is bred for stubborn terrain and stubborn riders. These massive, horned canines hail from the old D?zenkell peaks, where they?ve hauled dwarves, supplies, and even war banners into the fray. Once bonded, they charge without fear, and stories still echo of dwarf-led squadrons breaking minotaur lines astride these snarling, stomping brutes.

6064633895816593529.title: Mount Cosmetic: Imperial Destrier
6064633895816593529.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Trained for ceremony and conquest, the Imperial Destrier carries its rider with martial elegance. Draped in ornate armor and bred for discipline, it strides through palace courts and battlefield lines with equal dignity. As a mount, it symbolizes the reach and legacy of empire.

6064633895816724602.title: Cosmetic: Metal Hawk
6064633895816724602.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of specific mounts when you equip it.

6064633895841562762.title: Cosmetic: Rosebloom
6064633895841562762.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of specific mounts when you equip it.

6064633895860174993.title: Mount Cosmetic: Anvilian Warhog
6064633895860174993.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Broad-backed and battle-tempered, the Anvilian Warthog thunders through the high passes of northern Vandagar with a snort and a charge that sends boulders rolling. Native to the Anvils and steeped in legend, these tusked brutes have grown larger and meaner than the old tales ever dared suggest. Though notoriously ill-tempered, they can be broken to saddle by those with enough grit and stubbornness to match them. Favored by bold dwarves and reckless riders alike, the warthog is less a mount and more a living battering ram with a mind of its own.

6064633900513624067.description: Forged with the might of a maelstrom, this axe bears the pressure of unspoken depths. Its sweep is vast, its pull inexorable.

6064633900518670350.title: Mirageborn Sunwrought Axe
6064633900518670350.description: A soft blur clings to the edge at motion, a desert trick of air and light that guides the hand.

6064633900550193192.title: Dreadwake Gloomfang Great Axe
6064633900550193192.description: Finish near black with a wet sheen, as if the night itself agreed to ride the arc.

6064633900658983044.title: Verdant Oath Bloomcrusher
6064633900658983044.description: The Verdant Oath Bloomcrusher scatters petals unseen and unheard with each swing. Its presence stirs pollen from still air and leaves a sweet taste on the wind.

6064633900683231376.title: Glassveil Mirage Spear
6064633900683231376.description: Its surface bends the light in ways that unsettle the eye, like heatwaves over distant sand.

6064633900697976993.title: Stormcurrent Wavecaller Spear
6064633900697976993.description: Droplets cling unnaturally to its edge, as if the sea cannot bear to leave it.

6064633900698828963.title: Sunscorch Heatspire Spear
6064633900698828963.description: The metal burns in hue, deep as the last light of day over the Sandsquall wastes.

6064633900705251500.title: Coralblade Maelstrom-Longbow
6064633900705251500.description: Drawn through sea-tempests and brine-choked caverns, the Maelstrom-Longbow still sings with pressure from the deeps.

6064633900854673667.title: Nightreaver Veilbound Great Grimoire
6064633900854673667.description: Thread black sewing vanishes against the boards, and the tome opens without sound when the jungle holds its breath.

6064633900876497171.title: Runeweld Codex
6064633900876497171.description: The Runeweld Codex reveals hidden script in angled light, though no ink has been added. When read aloud, its pages seem to warm slightly, and nearby stones sometimes vibrate in reply.

6064633900878266649.title: Runeweld Sigilcleave
6064633900878266649.description: The Runeweld Sigilcleave glows briefly when cutting through enchantment and sings in low tones no ear quite catches. Its blade leaves afterimages shaped like old glyphs, visible only in still air.

6064633900909199670.title: Shadowfang Gloomfang Focus
6064633900909199670.description: A dark edge glints briefly before vanishing back into shade.

6064633900935151945.title: Stormcurrent Squallcrest Shortbow
6064633900935151945.description: Faint whorls ride the limbs like weather lines, flashing quick and gone.

6064633900935872843.title: Sunscorch Dawnflare Greatsword
6064633900935872843.description: A golden shimmer prowls the steel, restless and unyielding. Even in shadow, the blade casts its own light.

6064633901008945489.title: Sunscorch Emberglass Shortbow
6064633901008945489.description: A glassy warmth pools under the finish and holds without flare.

6064634098504499200.title: Protector's Pride
more: Bred in bastions and raised beside shields, the Protector's Pride is more than a mount. It is a living oath. With a broad frame and steadfast eyes, it endures hardship without complaint and charges danger without hesitation. Long used by elite guards and wandering sentinels alike, this loyal beast forms a bond as unbreakable as steel, guarding its rider with unflinching resolve.

165% Ground Speed

more: Lean and relentless, the Scalerunner is bred for motion without limits. Its muscular frame and clawed limbs give it the ability to ascend sheer cliffs, vault ravines, and race through tangled terrain. Hunters and scouts favor it for its balance of speed, stamina, and fearless climbing instinct.

6064634761958195221.description: A forge sentinel?s mantle that never forgot its duty. Heatless warmth gathers when danger nears, and hidden prayer spirals steady the breath. It carries the last kiln sigh of the blacksmith ruins, unspent.

6064634761969991736.description: Worn through more seasons than any clan ledger could hold, these breeches carry a bear?s stubborn calm. They root the wearer with wild patience, teaching when to stand firm, wait still, endure, and return.
